name: Chilean refrigerated-truck driver (accused; silhouette only)
depiction: The driver arrested in February 2012 in Chilean Patagonia with about five tonnes of ice from the Jorge Montt glacier in a refrigerated truck. ACCUSED only (theft charge reported; no court outcome found, checked 20 Oct 2026). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette: no face, no features; plain dark jacket. Never named. Not a likeness.
